name: FreeInkOpenType
description: FreeInkFont's OpenType layout readers on their own: GPOS pair kerning (resolved once or per call), GSUB ligatures and the legacy kern table. For a consumer that draws fonts its own way and wants none of FreeInkFont's FreeType or stb_truetype engines.
keywords: font, opentype, gpos, gsub, kerning, ligatures
